Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
It has just been pointed out to me that the Anarchs rulebook included an
announcement for the next expansion : the Black Hand, coming out November
!!!

This inspires a few things to me :

- I'm glad this theme was chosen, and am sure there will be great things,
especially concerning big vampires
- I would have prefered a later date, because the players (myself included)
may have trouble following too frequent expansions, a) moneywise, and b)
gamewise (although the CE didn't bring that many changes, and Anarchs sure
doesn't seem as rich - and long to assimilate - as Bloodlines, but of course
that opinion is personnal)
- Will we see any new True Brujah and Nagaraja ???
- Does this open the door for the next expansion : The Inconnu ? Or will
this one also include a few intruders like VLAD or MONTANO ?!?!?!
- LSJ, I WANT/NEED to be a pre-tester !! Pretty please with blood on top ?
I'm the first one to ask... ;-)

All in all, I can't wait...

Orpheus

--
"When you dream, sometimes you remember
When you wake, you always forget".

Neil Gaiman

Messages.Author: Daniel Figueiredo
Messages.Body:
"Orpheus" <orph...@free.fr> wrote in message news:<3ec9521f$0$29723$626a...@news.free.fr>...


I´m pretty sure this will be the Sabbat Black Hand, not the "True
Hand"... So no Trujahs and Nagarajas.. (the True Hand was destroyed,
and the survivors scattered, but then again, the !Tremere were also
destroyed, so maybe we will see a little bit of both hands). I
personally also think that November is a bit early as well, but it´s
not like WW has officially announced it yet on their site or anything,
so they COULD still change the date. Granted, Anarchs is a small
expansion, but especially moneywise a date like Februrary or March
next year would be better. The single most important thing WW could do
to keep the spirit of players up along with their love of the game
they already have, which is announce another expansion, so it couldn´t
hurt to wait another 3 ou 4 months before we see it! :)
Montano would be very welcome indeed, tn any expansion!! I would
love to see him as the first 11cap Lasombra. Maybe alongside Yorak and
his Cathedral of Flesh or even The Dracon as a Tzimisce 11cap. Vlad
would be nice, but not as an 11cap... (I haven´t seen or heard news
from Velya yet, but I assume he is a 10cap Tzimisce since no one
bothered to say anything about him)
Including some Iconnu Monitors would be nice as well! Pity not much
else about the Iconnu can be introduced without WW having to make it
up first as there is little to no information (arguably a good thing).

And here goes nothing:
LSJ, I would also like to be considered for a playtester if at all
possible! I would be greatly honored to receive such a vote of
confidence.

Daniel Figueiredo, V:EKN Prince of Campinas, São Paulo.

LOL. Of course. But how long did it take to assimilate the expansion,
compared to Bloodlines ? Sure, we didn't get to test it all yet (luckily),
but there were few new cards, and many of the new vampires were variations
on possible strategies. I'm not saying it wasn't a good expansion, I think
it was, but the assimilation time wasn't as long as for Bloodlines (still
lots of variations I didn't get to try...).

> > Anarchs sure
> > doesn't seem as rich - and long to assimilate - as Bloodlines, but of
> course

Of course. Time will tell, and when I get enough of it I will develop, that
wasn't my goal here. No matter how long it will take us to digest the (few
in comparison to Bloodlines) new cards, and new "strategies" in Anarchs, I
still feel that Black Hand is coming too soon. But then, I guess WW doesn't
HAVE to get it at the time when it's announced ; however, my guess would be
that postponing it after Christmas would be a very bad commercial move,
so... :-(

(can't wait, on the other - black - hand...).

But if WW heeds what more than a few players just said here, maybe they will
space the next expansions a little more (one year would be fine in my book).

Orpheus

Not going to get into that, the two rules for a happy life being never
to start a land war in Asia, and never to get into an aesthetic
dispute with a French person [unless, of course, you yourself happen
to be Asian or French respectively].

However, i can't resist passing on the following wise observation from
Rob Treasure, to the effect that Week of Fortune really IS [or really
appears to be] the worst piece of card-art ever, even worse than Fee
Stake: Corte and Exuding Blood. Or so a shallow and unobservant person
might conclude. The Enlightened will see it for what it is - a fine
representation of a patch of dog-shit, with the purple heads of the
tape-worms shyly peeking through. Yes folks, we are into the brave new
world of Dog-Poo: The Eternal Stickiness.

O, and has anyone else noticed how nice the new cards smell?

Exuding blood is a bit..._active_, perhaps, but I wouldn't call it awful.
Fee Stake: Corte is just tedious. I'm not seeing the awfulness. And year
of Fortune is just a starry sky, is it not?

Have years of media coverage of the Royal Family destroyed all
ability to tell 'pretty' from 'icky' across the pond?

None of these cards is a patch on, say, Gerard Rafiq for sheer amateurishness
of execution and unpleasantness to behold, or the new artwork for (shudder)
Blood Puppy. Or Shotgun Ritual.

>O, and has anyone else noticed how nice the new cards smell?

No, but I'm very pleased with the coating. CE was too matte for my taste,
and the promo Vitels too glossy. Anarchs seems to have really hit the sweet
spot, varnish-wise. Mm. Sweet, sweet varnish. Why not drink some right now?
